sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Satin Rose Flower Hair Tie – Black & White Set of 2
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Elegant satin rose flower hair tie, set of 2 (black & white)
Soft stretchable elastic band, gentle on hair
Classic monochrome rosette design, pairs with any outfit
Perfect for daily wear, office, college & gifting
Doubles as a bracelet/wrist accessory when not in hair
Lightweight, no-damage grip for all hair types
